_readme: Each card serial's TCGplayer product ID. The Card Browser links a card to
https://www.tcgplayer.com/product/{id}. A serial with no entry is not on TCGplayer,
did not match, or is a Crystal token.
names holds TCGplayer's name for a card where it is not the card's own name: "Cocytus
EX", or "Squire (Male Unit)" and "Squire (Female Unit)" for two cards named Squire.
TCGplayer's Mass Entry finds cards by these names, so the Deck Manager's Buy Deck link
lists each card under its TCGplayer name where it has one.
Generated by tools/tcgplayer_mapping.py from tcgcsv.com's mirror of TCGplayer's
catalog. Regenerate it rather than editing it: hand fixes belong in that script's
OVERRIDES, and its report (target/tcgplayer-mapping-report.txt) lists every card that
was not a single exact match.
